items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Because we had done the Mildred Bailey show in the radio days, you know, with the trio.

ctx.x: I wanted to stay there and get my card and get my own little reputation. And we were going back to Chicago, you know, and Teddy Wilson was -- I think he was going to teach at Julliard at that point, you know, and he recommended

me. Because we had done the Mildred Bailey show in the radio days, you know, with the trio. We were getting booked all over the place. On CBS, you know, and NBC and all those places, and we just happened to hit it, if I can put it that way, you know? The timing was right, a unique trio, a violin, bass and piano, playing jazz. No drums or nothing, you know, just -- we were very fortunate that way. And I think it was a wise thing that I didn't go with Benny Goodman. And I just wanted to stay in New York and expand…
